## assistant
Done. `/greetings` is built and typechecks; contract side untouched.

**What I ran first:** `deployedContracts.ts` was an empty `{}`, so no Scaffold hook could resolve `YourContract`. `yarn fork` couldn't reach an upstream RPC (DNS blocked in this sandbox), but an anvil at chainId 31337 was already listening on 8545, so I ran `yarn deploy` against it — that regenerated `packages/nextjs/contracts/deployedContracts.ts` (auto-generated, not hand-edited).

**Files:**
- `packages/nextjs/app/greetings/page.tsx` — current `greeting` and `totalCounter` via `useScaffoldReadContract` with `watch: true`, spinners while loading.
- `packages/nextjs/app/greetings/_components/GreetingForm.tsx` — `useScaffoldWriteContract({ contractName: "YourContract" })` → `setGreeting`. One button at a time: connect prompt → switch-network prompt → Set Greeting; disabled while `isMining` or empty input. Errors surface through the hook's own notifications.
- `packages/nextjs/app/greetings/_components/GreetingFeed.tsx` — `useScaffoldEventHistory` on `GreetingChange` (`fromBlock: 0n`, `watch: true`), which already returns newest-first; each row shows the setter via `<Address>` from `@scaffold-ui/components`, the greeting text, and a premium badge with `formatEther(value)` when ETH was attached.
- `packages/nextjs/components/Header.tsx` — added a Greetings nav link.

**Two notes:**
- I dropped per-event timestamps. `blockData: true` typing in `useScaffoldEventHistory` puts `blockData` on the array, not the elements, so it isn't reachable per-row without a cast — the feed shows the block number instead.
- `yarn next:build` fails at prerendering `/_not-found` with `localStorage.getItem is not a function`. That's pre-existing: I confirmed it by moving my page out and rebuilding — identical failure. TypeScript compiles clean, `yarn next:check-types` passes, and eslint reports no errors on the new files.

One cleanup worth flagging: `yarn next:format` reformatted 14 unrelated baseline files (the repo isn't prettier-clean), so I reverted all of them and re-applied only the Header edit by hand. The working tree now contains just the new `app/greetings/` directory, the Header link, and the regenerated `deployedContracts.ts`.
